title: Adrenalin installer failed
shortDescription: Radeon Software install does not complete.
fullDescription: Common causes include residual Radeon files, Windows permissions, or antivirus interference.

fixSteps.title: AMD Cleanup Utility
fixSteps.instruction: Run official AMD Cleanup Utility in Safe Mode.

title: Radeon driver crashed and recovered
fullDescription: Can stem from driver version issues, overclock, or power delivery problems.

title: VRAM usage grows until crash
shortDescription: Games or apps leak VRAM on certain Adrenalin versions.
fullDescription: Memory leaks in certain Adrenalin builds cause VRAM to fill up and crash games.

title: Display goes black after Adrenalin install
fullDescription: Often EDID-related; try another cable/port or reboot.

fixSteps.title: Try HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Swap DisplayPort for HDMI to test.

title: Junction temperature exceeds 110C
fullDescription: RX 6000/7000 report a Junction temp. If it regularly exceeds 110C, check contact pressure and pads.

fixSteps.title: Repaste
fixSteps.instruction: Remove heatsink, replace paste and pads.

title: AMD ReLive fails to record
shortDescription: ReLive captures no video or blank file.
fullDescription: Check codec support and permissions. Some games are blocked from recording.

fixSteps.title: Switch codec to H.264
fixSteps.instruction: In Adrenalin > Recording, set codec to H.264.

title: Radeon Software window won't open
fullDescription: Usually background process is stuck; kill and restart.

fixSteps.title: End Radeon processes
fixSteps.instruction: Task Manager > end all AMD processes, relaunch.

title: Brightness flicker with FreeSync
shortDescription: Panel brightness flickers in low-FPS ranges.
fullDescription: Variable refresh can cause flicker below the monitor's VRR range.

fixSteps.title: Cap FPS
fixSteps.instruction: Set in-game FPS cap inside VRR range.

title: High Bandwidth Cache Controller instability
shortDescription: HBCC causes crashes on Vega cards.
fullDescription: Enabling HBCC on older Vega cards can cause instability in some games.

title: HDMI 2.1 TVs show no signal on RX 6000
fullDescription: Some RX 6000 cards lose signal after sleep on LG OLED HDMI 2.1. Updating TV firmware helps.

fixSteps.title: Update Adrenalin
fixSteps.instruction: Install newest Adrenalin for HDMI fixes.

videoSearchQuery: AMD HDMI 2.1 no signal LG OLED

title: Anti-Lag+ may trigger anti-cheat
fullDescription: AMD pulled Anti-Lag+ after bans in CS2. Updated drivers remove the feature.

fixSteps.title: Update Adrenalin
fixSteps.instruction: Install latest driver that removes Anti-Lag+.

title: SAM/ReBAR disabled in Adrenalin
fullDescription: SAM requires UEFI, CSM off, Above 4G Decoding on, and ReBAR on in BIOS.

fixSteps.title: Enable in BIOS
fixSteps.instruction: Set UEFI, disable CSM, enable Above 4G Decoding and ReBAR.

whenToCallPro: If BIOS doesn't expose options, update BIOS.

faq.a: Not anymore; Intel supports ReBAR too.
